verdict.rationale: The vendor states plainly that "Nothing is uploaded" and that Filee works offline, so files never leave the computer. The architecture backs this up: conversion engines (7-Zip, FFmpeg, LibreOffice, Calibre, Ghostscript, Pandoc) are bundled or installed locally, Office and HWP formats convert natively without external apps, and the product is MIT-licensed open source. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on verification (e.g., a network-traffic audit) confirming that no data is transmitted during conversion.
